personal.title: Software Engineer
personal.bio: Backend developer with professional experience building backend systems, business applications, and integrations using Python, Django, and Frappe/ERPNext. Focused on developing reliable APIs, automating business workflows, and integrating business systems.

skillsFootnote: Focused on reliable backend systems, practical integrations, and maintainable software.

points: Develop and customize Frappe/ERPNext applications using Python, JavaScript, and Vue.js to support business workflows and international requirements.
Developed a Construction Management System with a Vue.js frontend and Frappe backend, implementing industry-specific workflows and business logic.
Implemented UK address lookup and validation using Ideal Postcodes, reducing customer address creation and validation time from approximately 2 minutes to 30 seconds.
Worked on a UK HMRC CT600 Corporation Tax integration involving tax data processing, reporting workflows, and electronic submission components; the overall integration remained unfinished.
Develop custom DocTypes, workflows, APIs, reports, and integrations using MariaDB, Docker, Git, and Linux.
Developed and customized Frappe/ERPNext applications for business domains including real estate, HRMS, point of sale, and maintenance management.
Built custom DocTypes, reports, print formats, dashboards, and workflows to support business-specific requirements.
Implemented role-based permissions, server-side scripts, and application logic to extend ERPNext functionality.
Worked on database migrations, application testing, and maintenance of existing business applications.
Developed a shipping connector using Django, Django REST Framework, and PostgreSQL to integrate backend services.
Implemented REST API functionality and API documentation using Swagger.
Customized Odoo functionality using Python and XML to support business requirements.
Developed Django functionality for sales and product management applications.
Worked with SQL data and explored data analysis using Python libraries including Pandas and NumPy.
Implemented and maintained backend logic to support application functionality and business requirements.

projects.name: HMRC CT600 Integration
projects.description: UK Corporation Tax Reporting and Submission Integration
points: Developed core components of an integration for processing UK Corporation Tax data and supporting CT600 reporting workflows.
Worked on XML and iXBRL document processing for tax computations and supporting accounts.
Contributed to electronic submission workflows, including HMRC Gateway interactions, submission acknowledgements, polling, and IRmark-related processing.
Completed more than 80% of the development work undertaken before leaving the project; the overall integration was not completed.

projects.name: Construction Management System
points: Developed a construction management application with a Vue.js frontend and Frappe backend.
Implemented construction-specific business logic and workflows to support operational processes.
Integrated frontend functionality with backend application services and data models.

projects.name: UK Address Lookup and Validation
points: Integrated Ideal Postcodes address lookup and validation into Frappe/ERPNext customer workflows.
Reduced customer address creation and validation time from approximately 2 minutes to 30 seconds, a 75% reduction.
Improved address entry efficiency by reducing manual data entry and supporting postcode-based address lookup.

projects.name: Frappe/ERPNext Business Applications
projects.description: Custom ERP Applications and Business Process Automation
points: Developed and customized more than 15 Frappe applications containing over 120 DocTypes.
Built more than 20 reports and implemented business workflows across real estate, HRMS, POS, and maintenance applications.
Implemented custom permissions, print formats, scripts, and reports to extend standard ERPNext functionality.
Worked on database migrations, application maintenance, and business process automation.

achievements: Honourable mention at the 8th Ethiopian Collegiate Programming Contest (ETHCPC).
Quarterfinalist in the A2SV Generative AI Hackathon.
Earned the HackerRank Python Basic certification in January 2023.

activities.title: Competitive Programming Organizer
items: Contributed to organizing collegiate programming competitions over three years.
Participated in competitive programming activities and technical problem-solving.

activities.title: Security & CTF Practice
activities.description: Application security and Capture the Flag challenges
items: Practise Capture the Flag challenges to strengthen security analysis and problem-solving skills.
Study the OWASP Top 10 and common web application security vulnerabilities.
